'''Beldon''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pamorjal]] and was the main center of trade there. Souvenirs from the [[Temples of Vormijj]] were on sale in the market there.
